reviews.title: Constant Flight Delays
reviews.text: As my airline of choice I’m a regular on Yeti Airlines however this is about to change. The constant delays and the feeble excuses for it are driving me mad. This needs to be addressed asap as my tolerance level is running dry!!
reviews.author: Bijayant S

reviews.title: Not reliable at all, last moment they denay the schedules
reviews.text: I planned my travel for visiting Kathmandu with my Parents and kids, but 1 day befor I got alert on mail that both inbound and out bound flights are suspended. we made all hotel and vehicle bookings in advanced based on our Flight tickets, but due to cancelling of flight by Yeti Aerlines without providing or supporting alternatives has really forced us to raise question on its reliability.
reviews.author: chandandeo

reviews.title: Flight Delayed and No Proper Information Provided.
reviews.text: Flight delayed for two hours while passengers were already on plane. It was too hot and the clear information we're not provided to the passengers.
reviews.author: Sizar A

reviews.title: Terrible flight experience with no proper information about flight reshedule
reviews.text: Focus on customer service and maintenance of aircraft. Too old aircraft and I don't give s*** attitude from service staff on the ground with no proper information available to passengers.
reviews.author: Rupesh S

reviews.title: Worst service and even worse planes.
reviews.text: Worst airlines ever. Lots of crash. Please travel by bus or van but please avoid all nepali domestic airlines specially yeti.
reviews.author: John

reviews.title: Flight cancelation
reviews.text: Bad service, misleading information and expensive. All the flights are late we are waiting in the airport for 3 hours delay time and still no sign of flight
reviews.author: Rima

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Please announce why and how long are you going to delay. Time matters. You could really make some effort to apologise. I am never booking again.
reviews.author: Nigya S

reviews.title: Honestly, avoid this company flights.
reviews.text: Repetitive delays on purpose. I’ve travelled from this airlines a few times, they’ve never been flying on time. They always merge their flights as they are never full of passengers. Regardless, they make some nonsense excuses.
reviews.author: bibas

reviews.title: Alert!!! Don't fly at YETI AIRLINES
reviews.text: Don't fly at Yeti Airlines. Repeatedly cancels flight at last hour. Staff misbehaves at counter rather handling customer queries. REASON TO CANCEL: Not availability of planes due to maintenance.
reviews.author: Yuvaraj

reviews.title: Avoid this airline if possible or plan for a 2 to 3 hours delay
reviews.text: They initially delayed the flight by 50 mins, for which we received the intimation a week in advance - not appropriate, but could still plan around it. Once we reached the airport, they continued to delay the flight 30 mins every 10-15 mins. And the only way we'd get to know that was by looking at the board - no announcements were made - funnily enough they even gave up on that after sometime with the departure time showing up as '00:00'. A flight of theirs that was supposed to take off 2 hours prior to ours, took off at our assigned departure time - so much for timeliness. Our flight eventually took off 2.5 hours after the already delayed departure time.
reviews.author: Shash123

reviews.title: unpleasant experience
reviews.text: firstly the flight was delayed and on the top of that, one of the cabin crew member named kalpana tamang was not very welcoming and she was not at all helpful when i wanted help with my backpack to go on the overhead bins as i had my wrist injured. she was just standing there ignored me and did not help me although i asked for help. the two guys behind me got her attention when clearly i needed her help and was struggling. i lost my confidence and lost all my hope with the airline crew all because she made me feel unwelcomed and unwanted although i paid equal amount of money just like everyone else paid. i've never booked flights with yeti since. an extremely bad and heartbreaking experience for me.
reviews.author: DG

reviews.title: Delayed flight more then 1 hour
reviews.text: 1st time I fly with yati airplane but ended with bad experience flight time was 7.15 pm ended up with delay till 8.40pm there for no information what time the flight will be? Better to choose Buddha Air line in future
reviews.author: Amit

reviews.title: Very POOR service, DONT TRAVEL VIA YETI AIR
reviews.text: The Yeti airlines provide a very pathetic service. The man handled my luggage at the airport and broke my suitcase handle. Now they don’t want to compensate by making a very flimsy excuse. I suggest you guys to NEVER travel via yeti airlines.
reviews.author: Smarika Speaks Truth

reviews.title: Horrible experience !PROVIDE ME A PROPER EXPLANATION!
reviews.text: 29th July our flight was at 10:30 which was delayed by 5 minutes and we were looking for the corporation from the team at the counter of yeti airlines but they informed the flight was taken off already he gave us an option to change our time to 13:10 with additional charges which we agreed .Him knowing our return ticket is on the same day by 13:55 he told us we will have 20 min after landing which was more than enough for me to get my things done . One thing that was frustrating was the new booking which we made for 13:10 was again delayed by 15 min , the departure was supposed to be done by 13:10 which didn’t happened and the time I managed to get my work done in janakpur was been wasted waiting for the departure from ktm airport .The men’s at the airport were very rude dnt wanted to understand the situation at all very unprofessional It was a horrible trip, Requested if we can change the return ticked at janakpur airport got the same response again knowing there was a delay from the airlines itself THE TEAM WERE JUST BLAMING EACH OTHER FOR THE DELAY and they charged us again ! IF YOU CONCERN ABOUT TAKING MONEY PROVIDE US THE BETTER SERVICE . HERE WHEN THE FLIGHT IS DELAYED BY CUSTOMER’S SIDE THE OPTION IS TO PAY AND CHANGE THE TICKET BUT WHEN ITS BEEN DELAYED BY THEM WE JUST WAIT? Yeti airways has to come up with better solution ! didn’t expected this terrible experience at all. Yeti airways If you really concern about your service Do provide me a clear explanation on this .
reviews.author: Smarka

reviews.title: Full Flight
reviews.text: Flight was 100% full from Pokhara to KTM which made for very cramped conditions especially for anyone over 6' and they were not allowing use of overhead space. Fortunately it is a short flight. On plus side airline did require masks and provided face shields before boarding flight.
reviews.author: Doug V

reviews.title: Much Better than BUDDHA Air
reviews.text: Everything went very smooth, from ticket purchase to check-in to boarding. Pilot's Announcement was another pleasant surprise. Over-all it was a nice experience. Bravo Captain Chand !!
reviews.author: Mt-8848

reviews.title: Fly with Yeti
reviews.text: I had many experiences with yeti airlines. I would say it is a bit better compared to others in terms of service and also you get snacks even on your short trip. You need to be mindful that you are going to have a bit delay on your flight but I believe these days they are trying to change it since there are more aircraft flying to Pokhara-Kathmandu.
reviews.author: David S

reviews.title: Flights NEVER on time!
reviews.text: The travel agency booked Yeti airlines from Katmandu to Pokhara in order to save time travelling time on road and also had a senior citizen travelling with us. It was informed, The flight was scheduled every hour we have to be 2 hrs early for check-in and bording. we were early and in waiting area which was very full with no seats to sit in airport, but sat on the ground during waiting. Mind you, the airport is not airconditioned. The flight was delayed by 2 hrs!!! Our waiting time was almost 4hrs in the airport!!! 1 hr for the flight journey total 5hrs ++ to reache Pokhara. We were expecting return journey would be better, but it was the same plight. seems like the passengers are used this kinda administration! we were very frustrated with the entire journey plan, it consumed almost 1 day waiting in the airport. BUT! Buddha Airlines, were also scheduled every hour and they were ONTIME all the time!!! The ticket cost is almost the same. Lesson learnt! Book Buddha Airlines instead of Yeti.
reviews.author: Blue W

reviews.title: Always late, quaint and scenic!
reviews.text: We have flown Yeti dozens of times. Your choices are limited and we have found Yeti better than Buddha or Royal Nepali and Yeti also flies to the smaller airports. We have been delayed more than on time. This is due to the volume of traffic in and out of the high altitude airport at Kathmandu and is beyond Yeti's control. Usually fly on a worn gulf stream turbo-prop that seats about 35 and is clean enough. All flights have been uneventful. Get a window seat on the North facing side of the plane for an incredible view of Anapurna range and the surrounding Himalayas. Getting off the bus that transfers you from the gate to the plane is the key. Try to be towards the last on the bus and at the door of the bus to be first off and on the ramp to the plane to get a North facing window seat. You watch them manually load your bag or backpack onto the plane. This is what flying was like 80 years ago. Flights are all short. Nepalgunj is 50 minutes. Butwal is 38 minutes. Seats are tight. You will pay 3 times what a Nepali or Indian will pay. This is aggravating but part of getting around in Nepal. We experience this all over India as an acceptable practice. Should we begin charging Indian nationals three times the entry fees and airfares in the West? Namaste.
reviews.author: mikeej99

reviews.title: Basic
reviews.text: Basic service on basic airplanes. Short journey, so can`t complain if not 5 star service Pleasant enough trip,but not cheap!
reviews.author: frances1803

reviews.title: Delay delay and delayed...
reviews.text: 12.10 flight changed to 12.50 then 1.40 and then 1.45 and actual take off at 2.15pm. Delayed 2 hours. Was just sitting at the airport.
reviews.author: Vicky

reviews.title: Annapurna Base Camp here we come
reviews.text: This was a short (30 mins) flight taken instead of the 8 hour bus ride option, well worth the extra expense. As on a previous flight on the same airline, the windows were dirty and coupled with the outside air pollution - don't expect to be taking any photo's.
reviews.author: EasygoingSydney

reviews.title: Flight comparable to domestic in Australia
reviews.text: I recently took this flight with yeti airlines and was remarkably surprised at the standards. The plane and flight was comparable with any domestic flight I take within Australia. Smooth landing and flight, excellent attendants, you receive water poured from the bottle into individual cups,a wrapped mint and cotton balls if needed. Get a right hand side seat on the way to Pokhara to see the stunning Annapurna range. I did arrive at the airport an hour early and realised my flight had been moved to an hour earlier than expected so walked straight in after security, waited in a mini bus (this is very old) and was driven to the plane in the tarmac. An email had apparently been sent alerting me however had gone straight to my junk mail. Hold on to your tickets (small stub)as this is needed to exchange for your luggage, Flight back to Kathmandu was a long wait due to heavy pollution and no planes could fly, 2.5hrs delay. Keep a close eye on the computer monitors as this was very busy and security lines were very long. Once in lounge, hover near the airline staff so you can hear when they yell out your flight. You don’t get to move into the lounge until you’re flight appears on monitor and this area also very busy, cafeteria upstairs for meals and very limited snacks.
reviews.author: Gemma

reviews.title: terribly dirty windows make a poor visual experience
reviews.text: This was a round trip ktm ktm mountain view flight yeti everest express. The staff was very friendly and informative. However, I have never endured windows that are this dirty, ever, on any flight, ever. This is a VIEWING flight and yet and windows were dirty and greasy. I felt bad for those people behind me whose view was of the engine !!! DO NOT use this airline.
reviews.author: Bill H

reviews.title: Old planes flown by excellent pilots
reviews.text: Very old planes operating like a bus taking trekkers and climbers up to ad back from Lukla the gateway to Everest Base Camp . It’s a frightening flight but the ladies and gents flying the plane are excellent and if the planes delayed it because of the weather made it impossible. This happened on the way up and I choppered it up but the planes fly as best they can. If you are using this flight you need to realise these flights can be delayed sometimes for days when even the choppers don’t fly. So give yourself leeway on any connecting flights
reviews.author: barcaranger

reviews.title: Ridiculous!
reviews.text: When I checked in, they put me on an earlier flight, and then the flight was delayed to exactly the same time as my original flight, and finally my original flight started to board and this earlier flight still delayed!! WTF is that! unbelievable!
reviews.author: Chiya666

reviews.title: Mountain flight
reviews.text: Airport process chaotic. Had to hang around in a bus on the tarmac for an hour until we took off, but the flight was stunning. Beautiful clear skies, window seat for everyone. A brief trip to the cockpit, a glass of fizz and an hour in the presence of the highest mountains in the world. We got much closer than I thought we would. Got to be done!
reviews.author: mazzaintazza

reviews.title: Worst Service Ever
reviews.text: I had 16 hours of flight and I had to fly from ktm to bharatpur at 3pm but the flight was delayed. The time of delay was not fixed. They don't even notified if the flight was about to board or not. After 2 hours the flight was announced and we board to the plane. But again after the wait of half hour, they told that flight was cancelled. They just said sorry and told that money will be returned. Even baggage was not distributed systematically as random person was entering to the baggage area. That's crazy. They dont even manage anything for the passangers. Totally upstting as they made the passangers wait for hours and at the end they just sent us away without any concern. Definately not gonna take this flight again.
reviews.author: Sujit C

reviews.title: Quick and relatively seamless trip from Chitwan to Kathmandu
reviews.text: We opted to fly Yeti from Chitwan back to Kathmandu. No problem with the airline, left pretty much on time, the flight was comfortable and is only a short flight. No in flight entertainment but for the length of the flight it is not required. I should also mention that our tour leader arranged the tickets and check-in so cant comment on this experience. I would fly Yeti again.
reviews.author: Marek P

reviews.title: Delayed !!!!
reviews.text: Our flight is 11am , but the flight is taking off 2pm. Waste time with no seat to wait. The windows are scratching, so we cannot clearly see the mountain view. Tbh, $25 is not worth for this short flight.
reviews.author: Onjira T

reviews.title: Yeti Airlines
reviews.text: We travelled from Pokhra to Kathmandu by Yeti Airlines and time taken is about half an hour. They are providing water and capacity is less than 100. All members have checked in and flight was ready, but it was delayed about 2 hours due to visit of Chinese Premier. It is better to keep in check in baggage rather than hand luggage
reviews.author: Balasubramanian R

reviews.title: Quick flight
reviews.text: This flight was quicker than the other Yeti flight I had flown on as soon as we took off we basically had 5 minutes at crushing altitude before our landing
reviews.author: Harrison T

reviews.title: Do NOT fly in YAK AND YETI
reviews.text: Yak and yeti will be observing and looking at you to make extra money , DO NOT TRAVEL IN Yak and yeti , we did not even get to take our hand carry when everyone are allowed same size same weight as us and to top that they also weight your personal bag !
reviews.author: Miya M

reviews.title: Best airline in Nepal
reviews.text: Yeti Air is by far the best airline in Nepal the worst part is lots of people I know said Yeti was the worst but they were wrong boarding was good and the flight was calm
reviews.author: Harrison T

reviews.title: Always running late
reviews.text: We wanted to spend a couple of days in Pokhara, so we bought tickets through Yeti. If it were not Nepal, you would think that you were in Mayberry RFD in 1960. They were running so late with the flight before us, that they put us on that flight (one hour late late for everyone else, but on time for us). We were late getting out of Pokhara coming back. The problem is the layed-back staff. We woke up the man at the check-in desk, just 30 minutes before our flight was supposed to leave. Very disorganized. But we did not feel unsafe. The pilots are skilled.
reviews.author: dr.jth

reviews.title: good airline
reviews.text: We booked our flight Pokhara to Kathmandu in person at the Yeti office in Pokhara (what is not at the airport). We also booked a mountain flight to see Mount Everest. Flights were lower priced than by using an agent. And as we had to deal with a cancellation due to bad weather before and had booked thru a hotel, this was a much directer and economical way. Service was good, flights were both excellent and smooth, service at airport both times was very good. No room for overhead luggage as they are small airplanes.
reviews.author: Frans d

reviews.title: Smooth
reviews.text: When I was at kathmandu at the first time I fly from kathmandu to pokhara with other airlines because I was not well know about this airlines after my guide Utsav recommend me this airlines and fly from pokhara back to kathmandu.During the flight period hostess provide some little snacks and drinks which was lovely to have during the flight.Flight was really smooth but landing was bit afraid.I heartly thanks to my guide utsav and this airlines for providing new experience in Nepal.
reviews.author: Siliva M

reviews.title: Just like the Creature
reviews.text: Small & Scary. But one hell of an amazing ride. Enjoyed the to & fro journey. Amazing experience. Aircraft is cozy & compact. No store away cabins in some of its aircraft's. One of the best airlines to travel in this region. Would definitely fly with them again. They have been on schedule and are always on time as hear from fellow passengers as well.
reviews.author: Marino D

reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.text: Great local airlines in pokhara. we fly from pokhara to kathmandu with this airline one year ago. During the take off and landing it was smooth and the air hostess was really kind.
reviews.author: bors b

reviews.title: Paisa Vasool Flight of my life
reviews.text: This was the shortest flight of my life, you would feel old school with the way check in process to receiving ur bags at the destination process works, i somehow liked it as i was damn bored with the normal process big and busy airports follows, reach early and request at the check in counter to allot you window seat on the right side while going to PKR from KTM and vice versa, this is give u mesmerising view of snow kissed Himalayan ranges, checkout the pics i have attached, you might feel wish this flight could have been more than 25 mins which would allow ur eyes to enjoy more and more of beautiful Himalayan ranges. Must fly with Yeti airlines for this route.
reviews.author: Aalok Pandey

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: In the context Nepal is not a modern metropolis (which is an attraction in itself), I totally enjoyed my flight. If you want caviar & champagne before boarding, then pretend you're important, and go to Europe or North America. Here, I wasn't hassled by rude security. The gate lounge is very basic, but staff are friendly. A warm smile and polite bow greets you as you board. This flight gives a wonderful perspective of Kathmandu and surrounding towns. Pretty soon, you get glimpses of the Himalaya's - there's excited chatter among passengers!! The runway at Lukla is slightly inclined, to assist in deceleration - Newton's Law of Gravity works just fine here = ) Off memory, the flight was approx. 35mins. It might be worth purchasing lollies or gum in Kathmandu to help equalise your ears. Also, make sure you have plenty of water to sip (if delayed on the taxi-way which can be hot/humid) - remembering heavy cloud can build @ Lukla. Seating is typically arranged, 1 column on the left (port side), and 2 columns on the right (starboard side). BEST VIEWS ARE FROM THE LEFT SIDE = ) I've been twice, maybe a 3rd time beckons? Remember, there's no Business Class here. Things are basic. That said, the experience will stay with you for life - enjoy the ride (and bragging rights, you've just touched down at a stunning place = )
reviews.author: Anthony M

reviews.title: Memorable experience
reviews.text: Very courteous staff.Though it was half an hour flight we were provided refreshment and kids were given toffees and juice. Magazines were there to be read Our airlines should learn from this.Indian airlines do not provide any service to economy class passengers
reviews.author: Ruchi

reviews.title: Short and smooth flight
reviews.text: First time taking a flight where I can see the propellers out of the window. On time and pretty smooth. One flight attendant who gave out peanuts and water during the short 25 mins journey. Try to get the single seat row next to the window to enjoy mountainous views.
reviews.author: Lynn

reviews.title: 3/10 based on what I would expect flight to Everest
reviews.text: Very late departure and staff and bus driver did not seem to know where the plane was - 1.5 hours waiting after flight time in the hot muggy bus on the tarmac - Flight eventually boarded and some of us did not even get a window seat (on a sight seeing tour???) - tiny dirty obstructed windows - we did eventually get a great view of Everest and the entire range - but not ad described and the plane was not designed for sight seeing - great cramped window shots of Everest but Id do something different if I did it again
reviews.author: 1972-team-canada

reviews.title: Flight ok, but very late!
reviews.text: The plane was a bit dated but ok, the staff were friendly, and most importantly for flying, I felt safe. A delay of 3.5hrs for a 30min flights was annoying, especially whilst we watched several Bhudda Air flights come and go. But the cafe deck at Pokhara airport was ok, and they have surprisingly good food. It was cloudy so we only caught the smallest glimpse of what could have been great mountain views.
reviews.author: redbagnz

reviews.title: Very comfortable
reviews.text: I fly with ATR aircraft of yeti. It was wonderful experience in domestic flight with clear view. Seat was very comfortable and a cup of coffee energize you for moment.
reviews.author: razz42

reviews.title: Best of the Airlines
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience with this little Airline... We came in late with Thai Airways from Bangkok, a 1 hour delay. Very quickly, we adapted the Nepali style and shouldered our luggage, as it can't be pulled over the rocky mud path to the domestic terminal. We were so lucky, that Yeti Airlines also had a little bit of a delay and understandably as they are dealing with extreme weather conditions in this part of the world, they are more flexible. Passengers are given the option to fly whenever there's a seat available on the next plane, which is hourly. We waited for about 20 minutes before boarding the next plane and were offered a refreshment, such as a soft drink and peanuts, which was very kindly given out to all waiting Yeti Airlines passengers. On the aircraft, ready for a 30min flight, the stewardess handed out some hard candy to suck on for take off. This reminded me of flying around the world with my parents as a child - we were always given candy for take-off to release the air pressure via jaw movements. It may also help people who feel fear of flying. What a nice practice!
reviews.author: julesheart2018

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: Their tag line of fly on time come true sometimes.. better than BuddhaAir about time..esewa booking has problem in mobile app.
reviews.author: manish p

reviews.title: Some good, some not so good
reviews.text: Good clean plane. Food was average but did not expect any on a flight of just over an hour. Flight attendants not very communicative but again flight was just over an hour and cabin was full so they were busy serving food. Flight was over 30 minutes late leaving and no reason was given.
reviews.author: Super_Ted_Top_Gun

reviews.title: Flight from Phaplu to Kathmandu
reviews.text: Hilarious flight! Tiny plane with seating for 18 people. The take off is from a high runway so views are spectacular. Thankfully only a 40 minute journey, but great fun. The pilots are clearly very experienced in high altitude flying so felt safe all the way. This was at the end of a 2 week trek without proper washing.....we were definitely the smelliest people on the plane!
reviews.author: dianachaloner
